context.transcript:
Thanks for coming in, Vivek.
As we discussed on the phone, I'm looking for an assistant to help my manager, Jessica, run the farm.
She'll be participating in the interview.
Hello.
Nice to meet you, Jessica.
Same here.
I was happy to see on your application that you have quite a bit of experience growing vegetables.
Yes.
When I was in school, I worked on a vegetable farm during the summer.
I know that for this job, I'd be expected to help create the planting and harvesting schedules, though.
I haven't done much of that.
No problem.
Jessica will train you to do that.
I'll show you the spreadsheets that we use.
context.transcript_translation:
谢谢你来，Vivek。
正如我们在电话里讨论的，我正在找一个助理来帮我的经理Jessica运营农场。
她将参加面试。
你好。
很高兴认识你，Jessica。
我也是。
看到你的申请表上说你有相当多的种植蔬菜的经验，我很开心。
是的。
我在学校的时候，夏天曾在一家蔬菜农场工作过。
我知道对于这份工作，我预计需要帮助制定种植和收获时间表。
我没有做过太多这种事情。
没关系。
Jessica会培训你做到这一点。
我会给你看看我们使用的电子表格。
